title: Inverse Linear Quadratic Gaussian Games: Constrained Setting and Transferability
summary: This work addresses finite-horizon inverse linear quadratic Gaussian games. In a constrained setting, we characterize the set of cost parameters and optimal dual values that generate a given generalized Nash equilibrium, and we propose an algorithm to compute these parameters.
